result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers use a dark monospace table with wide message columns, fixed field columns, and level labels in color with row tinting. B is tighter: all 14 lines fit, it adds filter chips, and its columns line up cleanly, so it is the better pick for quick scanning. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers use a monospace font on a dark theme, with fixed-width columns and wide message areas where long lines wrap at about 95–100 characters.
